consent.purpose: Stores your cookie choice so the banner is not shown again.

access.purpose: Sign-in session (HttpOnly). Set only when you sign in.

refresh.purpose: Keeps you signed in (HttpOnly). Set only when you sign in.

hasSession.purpose: Tells the page that a sign-in session exists.

cloudflare.purpose: Bot protection and security checks by Cloudflare, which delivers this site.

turnstile.purpose: Anti-spam check on forms, inside Cloudflare's frame.

gaSession.purpose: Keeps the state of a visit for anonymous statistics.
